unit_statements_verbatim: The minor requires at least 18 units.

notes.text: The minor in cybersecurity combines both theoretical concepts and technical skills to prepare students for a career in cybersecurity while incorporating their major field of work. Students will have the full flexibility to have both breadth and depth in various areas of cybersecurity, including offensive operations, networking, forensics, information security management and web security.
